extracted.name: Easy Fruit Dip
extracted.description: This yogurt fruit dip recipe is creamy, tangy, and lightly sweet. Easy to make with 5 ingredients, it's a perfect healthy snack! I also love to serve it at parties and gatherings. It's always a hit!
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, stir together the Greek yogurt, honey, peanut butter, cinnamon, and salt. If the dip is too thick, stir in water, 1 teaspoon at a time, until it reaches your desired consistency. Taste and adjust as desired.
Serve with fresh fruit for dipping. Store leftover dip in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days.
